title: The median
hints: The median is the middle value once the numbers are in order, so sort (a copy of) the input first.
With an odd count, the median is sorted[n/2]. With an even count, it's the average of the two middle values, sorted[n/2-1] and sorted[n/2].
s := slices.Clone(nums); slices.Sort(s); n := len(s); if n%2 == 1 { return s[n/2], true }; return (s[n/2-1] + s[n/2]) / 2, true
